title: Gateway SDK options
responsibility: Builds isolated SDK options for a local Claude gateway session.

inputs.name: gatewayOptions.session
inputs.description: The GatewaySession whose controller becomes the abortController of the SDK request, so aborting session.controller aborts that request. Only session.controller is read, and session is not checked for null or undefined.

outputs.name: gatewayOptions
outputs.description: SDK options with empty tools and settingSources, no persisted session, partial messages enabled, model claude-opus-5-5, effort xhigh, permissionMode dontAsk, cwd /tmp, strict-mcp-config and no-chrome flags, and the session controller. Copies process.env except ANTHROPIC_*, CLAUDE_CODE_USE_* and CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN. The executable is HARNESS_CLAUDE_EXECUTABLE when defined, otherwise HOME followed by /.local/bin/claude; neither value is validated. AbortController is omitted from the JSON examples.
